scope: Agent Review Summary groundedness and boundary validation
verified_claims: Unknown source_refs are rejected at top-level and nested paths.
Korean free-text repair, approval, causal certainty, downtime-saving, priority downgrade, and unsupported production-loss claims are rejected.
Data-quality hold summaries cannot invent inspection focus, confidence, or missing evidence.
Invalid LLM candidates fall back to deterministic summaries instead of being stored as trusted output.
Role summaries remain limited to the Operations roles and keep source refs grounded in the packet.
current_decision: Validation remains a release gate before any stronger orchestration engine or richer domain tool pipeline is promoted.
